The *Tatiyanāgavimānavatthu* (Vv 62) is a canonical Pali verse text in the *Vimānavatthu* collection [Catalog; SuttaCentral]. Translated by Bhikkhu Sujato under the title *Third Elephant Mansion*, the story relates a dialogue in which a man inquires of a *deva* about the specific meritorious actions that resulted in his rebirth in possession of a celestial white elephant [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records four translations of the text in four modern languages [SuttaCentral].

In terms of parallels and textual relations, SuttaCentral identifies a passage-level parallel to Pv 38 (*Nandakapetavatthu*) in the *Petavatthu*, while also registering cross-references or mentions in Ja 538 (*Mūgapakkhajātaka*), Pv 17 (*Maṭṭhakuṇḍalīpetavatthu*), Ja 529 (*Soṇakajātaka*), and Ja 532 (*Soṇanandajātaka*) [SuttaCentral].
